Card Q&A.q: Can I use the [End of All Turns] effect in this card's inherited effect to play this card itself when this card is in a Digimon's digivolution cards?

Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
[Start of Your Main Phase] If your opponent has a Digimon, gain 1 memory.
[All Turns] When any of your Digimon are played or digivolve, you may ＜Mind Link＞ with 1 of your Digimon with the [X Antibody], [DigiPolice] or [SEEKERS] trait.
(Rule) Also treated as Name: [Shuu Yulin] and has Trait: [DigiPolice].
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] This [X Antibody], [DigiPolice] or [SEEKERS] trait Digimon gains ＜Alliance＞ and ＜Reboot＞.
[End of All Turns] You may play 1 [Shuu Yulin] from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
